title: The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
description: Jesus' harsh judgment on the lukewarm church in Laodicea, which thinks it is rich but is spiritually wretched, poor, blind, and naked. He advises them to buy gold refined by fire, white clothes, and eye salve, and invites them to a meal: "See, I stand at the door and knock." The one who overcomes will be allowed to sit with him on his throne.
